## What's Changed
* Port setgist's local release workflow by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/52
* Add Usage Resets to the account menu for Claude and Codex by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/53
* Add Usage History as a settings dialog, ported from t3code by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/54
* Build worktrees out of their own way, so they stay small and T3 Code can clean them up by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/55
* List every banked usage reset with its own redeem button by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/56
* Move Updates under Deployment in the settings menu by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/57
* Replace the panel title with a refresh pill that shows freshness by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/58
* Tidy the toolbar: centred pills, a Settings label and a drag grabber by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/59
* Support typed Claude usage resets and the session-limit reset by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/60
* Flag provider outages on the account menu by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/62
* Show "Offline" in the refresh pill when the network is down by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/61
* Add Grok and OpenCode Go usage, and Grok, OpenCode and Antigravity history by @adampeterhiggins in https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/pull/63


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adampeterhiggins/usage-monitor/compare/v0.2.7...v0.2.15
